## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser. Nothing to install.
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** the **tasks PDF** with your answers, before lecture 11.
  About 30 minutes.
- **The model:** the website of the college gym (made up), with its
  booking form of Online activity 10.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary website website-builder site-navigation mobile-view publish-site >}}

## Step 1 · Three pages and a theme {.study}

- **Blank site** (+), then the site name: **College Gym**.
- **Pages › + New page**: **Booking** and **Contact**. The menu shows them
  by itself.
- **Themes**: one look (colours and fonts) for the whole site.

{{< sim file="sims/sites-gym-pages.html" poster="sims/sites-gym-pages.png" title="Sites Lab: the pages of the gym site" height="700" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Pages"}
Choose the right page.

::: {.match extra="Home|Contact"}
"Sunday to Thursday · 10:00, 12:00 or 14:00 · one hour."
:   Booking

    Why: The times are what the customer books.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A button to the form {.study}

- On the **Booking** page: **Insert › Button**. Name: **Book now**. Link:
  the link of the form.
- **Preview** (the eye), then click the button: the form opens.

{{< sim file="sims/sites-gym-button.html" poster="sims/sites-gym-button.png" title="Sites Lab: a button to the form" height="700" >}}

## Step 3 · Publish and check on a phone {.study}

- **Preview**, then **Phone**: the menu becomes ☰.
- **Publish**: type the web address (no spaces), then **Publish**.
  Customers open the site with this address.

{{< sim file="sims/sites-gym-publish.html" poster="sims/sites-gym-publish.png" title="Sites Lab: publish the site" height="700" >}}

## Step 4 · AI can write a friendly welcome {.study}

Only look and try here: the tasks do not need AI.

- On **tutudocs.com** (no sign-in) open the text of the Home page, then
  **AI Assistant**.
- Ask for one change: two short, friendly sentences.

{{< sim file="sims/tutu-online.html" poster="sims/tutu-online.png" title="Tutu Lab: AI writes the welcome text" height="700" >}}
